title: W's Unown-phabet
description: Brings the Unown font to Minecraft
body:
**Man.. I wish things were harder to read..**

## W's Unown-phabet

Inspired by a post in the [Cobblemon Discord](https://discord.gg/cobblemon) server as well as old projects from other people, I thought it would be funny to introduce Unown letters as a font for Minecraft. On top of the official characters, W's Unown-phabet has custom characters for everything found on a QWERTY keyboard.

Not what you're after? 3 different packs are available to cover as many use cases as possible.
### Pack A (All Characters)
![Pack A (All Characters)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/684b9197736faf37ad65a6a8e4e02dfc14a15a44.webp)

### Pack B (Letters Only)
![Pack B (Letters Only)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/644f9a0f2bde6509e95abd05a462c8bf53c41518.webp)

### Pack C (CAPS ONLY)
![Pack C (CAPS ONLY)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed432ae3356aa1bce1ee0964b4db3f7f99e8601f.webp)

Future updates (no promises)
- Cobblemon UI compatability
- Support for characters not in `ascii.png`

# Important Notes:
**For these packs to work, they must be put above any other packs that affect Minecraft's `ascii.png` file. Attempting to use bold lettering with make things even harder to read than usual. You have been warned.**
